provenance.thisIs: a DOWNSTREAM COPY, recorded so this repository's tree is not mistaken for the authority
provenance.mechanism: MANUAL COPY. No mirror, sync or checksum tool for this tree exists in any repository, and no test compares the two copies. A PNG changed upstream is NOT picked up here automatically.
provenance.whyTheSubsetIsNotDrift: No consumer requests a higher tier: this repository's URL template names the root PNGs, and the loader in gk-fusion loads the root PNGs. The 128 and 256 tiers have no reader in either repository today, and copying them here would cost roughly 360 KB in a web bundle for a tier nothing asks for.
provenance.elementTableOwner: The assets[] rows below restate gk-core's data/tuning/element-catalog.v2.json (id / hudGlyph / color) value for value. That catalogue is the OWNER; this table is a SNAPSHOT taken at generation time, and the catalogue wins if they disagree.
provenance.fileNamingIsTheContract: A glyph's file is <hudGlyph>.png at this tree's root. That convention is what both consumers depend on, and NEITHER reads this file - so the assets[].path column below restates the convention rather than describing a mapping anything loads.
provenance.verifiedOn: 2026-10-05 - the 6 root PNGs here are byte-identical to the authoritative tree's (SHA-256, all six). Compare before trusting that; nothing enforces it automatically.

source.prompt: Premium hand-painted arcane energy crest tokens, designed for a readable 64px actor HUD. Fire: scarlet/orange angular combustion crest; Ice: cyan/white crystalline frost crest; Air: turquoise vortex crest; Earth: ochre/emerald fractured geomantic crest; Light: gold/white vertical radiant prism, never a sun or star; Dark: violet/indigo fractured void rift, never a moon or crescent. Transparent background, no text.

normalization.crop: per-element alpha bounds, expanded 14% to preserve the energy silhouette

variants.64: root PNG files; the only tier this repository carries, and the only one any consumer requests

upstreamOnlyVariants.128: 128/<hudGlyph>.png; present in gk-fusion only. No reader in either repository today.
upstreamOnlyVariants.256: 256/<hudGlyph>.png; present in gk-fusion only. No reader in either repository today.
